verdict.rationale: Vue.js is an MIT-licensed, client-side UI framework distributed as a library. It has no hosted service or account system, so it has no API credentials to issue or scope. Least-privilege agent credentials are a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows Vue shipping any credential or API-key system.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
